summary: CoinShares PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting its extraordinary general meeting scheduled for September 15, 2026, as a virtual meeting. The filing attaches the notice of meeting and proxy statement, plus a related press release. The EGM is routine corporate governance, with no disclosed special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The notice covers procedural items including the record date of August 27, 2026, and virtual participation details. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned as the meeting relates to standard shareholder resolutions. This is a routine meeting notice and not a special situation.
